isolated_tail_definition: Union of candidate minus default source-normalized squared ink error >0.02 across analytic, direct-outline, PDFium and Poppler; identical code for financial and mixed

context-metrics.measurement: Complete original pages, source-relative native placement crops padded 4px; every visible draw. Includes raster/paper/neighbour context. Analytic=4x grayscale box average. Alternate renderer is Poppler for analytic and analytic for the other engines.
